question: ____ virtuoso, Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma, has revolutionized the role of the instrument in Hindustani music.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santoor**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit **Shiv Kumar Sharma** was a **virtuoso** of the **Santoor**, a traditional **Kashmiri** instrument.
 
• He is credited with **revolutionizing the role of the Santoor** in **Hindustani classical music**.
 
• He is an Indian Santoor virtuoso who is credited with shifting the instrument from a predominantly accompaniment and ensemble role in the Sufi music of Kashmir to a solo role in the Hindustani classical music tradition of North India.
